article.title: AdPlug擴展代理商版本，AI廣告修改須預覽並由人確認
article.title_en: AdPlug expands to agencies with per-platform permissions and change previews
article.summary: AdPlug公布代理商版本，讓團隊透過Claude、ChatGPT等工具處理多客戶Google Ads及LinkedIn Ads報告與操作。
article.summary_en: AdPlug announced an agency offering for reporting and operating multiple clients' Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads through tools including Claude and ChatGPT.
highlights: 擁有人可按成員及平台分別設定只讀或可編輯權限。
修改會列出活動、設定及新舊數值，由人確認後執行，並記錄操作者。
highlights_en: Owners set view-only or editing access separately for each member and platform.
Previews show campaigns, settings and old and new values; a person confirms changes and actions are logged.
article.why: 代理商可把跨客戶報告與寫入權限拆開，決定哪些同事只整理資料，哪些可批准預算或投放修改。
article.why_en: Agencies can separate cross-client reporting from write access and decide who may authorize budget or delivery changes.
article.next_step: 為一個客戶設定一名只讀及一名可編輯成員，檢查同一筆預算建議的預覽、批准及操作記錄是否符合分工。
article.next_step_en: Set up one viewer and one editor for a client, then check how a budget proposal appears in previews, confirmations and logs.
article.detail: 消息來自MarketersMEDIA發布的公司新聞稿，尚無獨立產品測試。Google Ads可經管理員帳戶接入其下客戶；LinkedIn報表可按職位、年資、公司及行業拆分。團隊亦可加入客戶目標、預算與品牌規則作背景。這些設計提供較具體的操作範圍，實際使用時仍需核對預覽的客戶、活動及修改數值。
article.detail_en: This is a company release distributed by MarketersMEDIA, not an independent product test. Google Ads manager accounts connect underlying clients; LinkedIn reporting can break down roles, seniority, companies and industries. Client briefs can supply goals, budgets and brand rules. Review the client, campaign and values in each preview.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
